critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: server.py had a critical typo on line 762 where the section comment and the @api_router.get('/widgets/weather') decorator were on the same line, making the endpoint unregistered (404). Restored to two lines. Weather widget now works. Main agent should review why iteration_7 report claimed this endpoint was OK.
server.py is now 931 lines — well past the 700-line soft limit. Recommend splitting into routers: auth, news, categories, settings, feeds, widgets, ads, pages, uploads.

Hydration warning in browser console: FeedSourcesTab has a <span> injected inside <option> in the category select — this is from the veditor tooling (x-source-* attrs) instrumentation and is harmless in production, but noisy in dev. No code change needed.
_sync_feed uses ET.fromstring on untrusted external XML — consider using defusedxml to prevent XML entity attacks (XXE, billion laughs). Low priority since sources are admin-added.
Test seeding: no cleanup path for news items imported by 'UI_TEST_FEED' if a UI-test crashes mid-run; consider tagging imported items with feed_id for reliable cleanup.
